instruction: Watch TV: I like to set on my sofa.Turn on the tv. And watch Perry Mason. Monday's through Friday's.

steps.title: task context · query symbolic state · list executable actions
steps.code:
import primitive_api as p, json
ctx = p.get_task_context(); print("CTX", ctx)
for s in ["sofa","tv","television"]:
    st = p.query_symbolic_state(scope=s)
    print("STATE", s, json.dumps(st)[:2500])
print("EXEC", p.list_executable_actions(query="sofa", limit=20))
print("EXEC", p.list_executable_actions(query="tv", limit=20))
